dct_description_sm: This dataset accompanies a forthcoming paper in the European Journal of Political Research (EJPR), which examines urban-rural policy disagreement in Canada. The dataset provided here includes a synthesized dataset of nearly 1,000 policy issue questions across ten distinct Canadian national election studies conducted between 1993 and 2021 (N=5.3 million).
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Urban-Rural Policy Disagreement
